subject: world_language
concept: Writing a well-structured persuasive essay with a clear thesis in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'write clear, detailed argumentative text' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a persuasive essay using a thesis/reasons/evidence organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes a persuasive essay with a clear thesis, supporting reasons, and appropriate connecting language

assessment.mastery_threshold: essay has a clear thesis, at least two supporting reasons, and appropriate connecting words
misconception_flags: writes an essay with reasons but no clear central thesis tying them together

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
